title: Project Scope
lede: Defined boundaries and core feature components included in the EvoSim simulation system.

items.title: Multi-Layer Perceptron Architecture
items.summary: Implementation of artificial neural networks equipped with sensory input vectors (environmental perceptions and internal vitals), dual hidden layers with ReLU activations, and discrete action output nodes for autonomous decision-making.

items.title: Evolutionary Training System
items.summary: Genetic algorithm infrastructure that tunes MLP synaptic weights and biases across generations using elitism, roulette/tournament selection, single-point crossover, and Gaussian weight mutation.

items.title: Competitive Hunger Games Arena
items.summary: A discrete 2D survival battle royale where competing organisms vie for finite nourishment and freshwater while evading predators and surviving starvation.

items.title: Dynamic Event & Disaster Engine
items.summary: Structured multi-tier events including sudden local hazards (meteors, rockslides), simulation-wide periodic disruptions (wildfires, harsh winters, flash floods), and triggered territorial conflicts.

items.title: Grid Map Navigation System
items.summary: Discrete coordinate grid navigation allowing animals to perceive local 3x3 Moore neighborhoods, compute path costs, and navigate heterogeneous terrain.

items.title: Spatial Neighbor-Aware Spawning
items.summary: Algorithmic generation of map entities that distributes flora, water pools, and competing animal categories with balanced density and fair initial conditions.
